title: Little Worlds: Enchanted Tree Library — Reference-Conditioned FLUX.2 Lab
purpose: Focused second-stage experiment using the selected page-35 composition as a visual reference. The experiment tests how different prompt structures instruct FLUX.2 Dev to transform the same cozy composition into a cute otherworldly storybook setting while rendering only clean black outlines with white interiors.
reference_guidance: Use the supplied image as a loose guide to major-object placement and cozy scale. Redesign the room as a tiny enchanted reading nook inside a giant hollow tree. Favor rounded forms and a few purposeful magical details, rather than replicating the realistic room or its gray tonal fills.
core_scene: An adorable enchanted reading nook inside the hollow trunk of a giant storybook tree, with one oversized rounded reading chair, one large arched tree-window, one curved bookshelf with a few broad books, one acorn-shaped side table holding one cup, one broad-leaf plant, and one simple round rug. Outside the window, two giant mushrooms and a few oversized flowers suggest a magical world.
visual_targets: Cozy and immersive composition inspired by the reference, transformed into an original enchanted setting.
Cute, rounded, friendly forms with whimsical architecture and only a few magical story cues.
Pure black outline coloring art on white paper: enclosed object interiors remain white and unfilled.
Form and depth communicated through contour lines and a few purposeful interior lines, rather than tonal fills.
Large, comfortably colorable spaces and medium-large secondary details.
Every visible object has an obvious purpose; no incidental symbols or busy micro-patterns.
One stable visual identity that can be reused throughout a 30–50-page book.

pages.label: A1 · concise baseline
pages.prompt: Reimagine the reference composition as an adorable enchanted reading nook inside the hollow trunk of a giant storybook tree. Keep one oversized rounded armchair, an arched window, one curved bookshelf with a few large books, one tiny acorn-shaped side table with a cup, one broad-leaf plant, and a simple round rug. Outside the window, show two giant mushroom silhouettes and oversized flowers. Pure black contour-only coloring illustration on clean white paper, blank white object interiors, bold rounded outlines, large easy-to-color regions, cute and uncluttered.

pages.label: A2 · world-first
pages.prompt: A tiny enchanted library hidden inside a giant living tree, using the reference image's cozy arrangement of a big reading chair, arched window, curved bookshelf, little side table, plant, and round rug. Cute rounded storybook furniture, a view of giant mushrooms and magical flowers beyond the window, a few broad book shapes, and simple natural tree curves. Crisp black contour lines on pure white paper, open white coloring areas inside every shape, spacious composition.

pages.label: A3 · style-first
pages.prompt: Original cute fairytale coloring-page line art: confident smooth black outlines, rounded friendly forms, generous white interiors, broad easy-to-color shapes, and only a few clean inner lines. Depict a cozy reading nook inside a giant hollow tree, with an oversized chair, arched window, curved bookshelf, acorn table with one cup, broad-leaf plant, and plain round rug. Giant mushrooms and oversized flowers peek through the window. A tiny magical world, charming and calm.

pages.label: A4 · composition-first
pages.prompt: Use a large rounded reading chair in the foreground, a tall arched window behind it, a curved built-in bookshelf on the left, a small acorn table and single cup on the right, one broad-leaf plant, and a wide plain rug. Transform the room into a cute enchanted library inside an enormous tree, with giant mushrooms visible outdoors. Black outline-only storybook drawing on white paper, clearly separated objects, simple interiors, large colorable shapes.

pages.label: A5 · playful rounded forms
pages.prompt: Create a cute little storybook world: a snug reading nook in a giant hollow tree, with a plump armchair, curved tree-trunk walls, a high arched window, a curved shelf holding a few big books, a tiny acorn-shaped table with one cup, one friendly large-leaf plant, and a broad round rug. Beyond the window are two oversized mushrooms and giant simple flowers. Pure black hand-drawn contours, white unfilled interiors, smooth rounded shapes, comfortably large spaces to color.

pages.label: A6 · purposeful details
pages.prompt: Redesign the reference as a tiny enchanted tree library. Every object should have a clear job: the big rounded chair is for reading, the curved shelf holds a few large books, the acorn table holds a cup, the plant decorates the nook, the arched window reveals giant mushrooms outside, and the rug grounds the chair. Show the magical world through the architecture and silhouettes. Render solely with crisp black outlines on white paper, with blank white interiors and large areas for coloring.
